pokedexEntries.sw: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

pokedexEntries.sh: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.
